rationale: Bounded expansion recovered a substantial FastAPI/Vertex AI inference-decoupling assertion in the candidate-supplied Google Cloud AI Traffic Safety Platform section. Generic setup and the contradicted VeriBridge workflow remain rejected. Its exact source states the architectural capabilities; approved GCP serving/main.py and vertex_client.py corroborate separate inference serving and local-model fallback behavior. The phrase for zero-downtime reliability describes the fallback purpose/capability, not a measured uptime SLA; no measured availability, user scale or production guarantee is inferred. This is meaningful system implementation, not package/model loading. One claim covers duplicate identical requirements with both original relationship identities retained and explicit decision reuse.
